title: Add comprehensive unit tests for all agent modules
problem_statement: Several core agent modules lack corresponding unit tests, risking undetected regressions.
risk_if_unaddressed: Regression bugs and decreased confidence in modernization changes.
suggested_approach: Create pytest-based unit test suites covering key functions, edge cases, and error paths for each agent module.
success_criteria: Test coverage > 80% for all agent modules
Automated tests pass in CI pipeline
Tests include error and edge case scenarios

provenance.evidence: Audit references agent modules but no direct test files found

title: Standardize error handling patterns across modules
problem_statement: Inconsistent try-except usage and error logging reduces maintainability and observability.
risk_if_unaddressed: Silent failures and difficulty diagnosing issues in production.
suggested_approach: Define and enforce a common error handling pattern with structured logging and re-raising or graceful degradation.
success_criteria: All modules use try-except with logging for expected exceptions
No bare except or pass statements
Error logs include context and stack traces

title: Enhance logging in deployment and system intelligence modules
problem_statement: Sparse logging in critical modules hinders troubleshooting and monitoring.
risk_if_unaddressed: Operational issues may go undetected or be difficult to diagnose.
suggested_approach: Implement structured and consistent logging at key steps and error conditions in these modules.
success_criteria: Logs include timestamps, severity levels, and contextual metadata
Key operations and errors are logged
Logging format consistent with other modules

provenance.evidence: Sparse logging observed in deployment logic
